presentation.description:
KeybindsPlus is a plugin that allows you to bind *almost* any key on your keyboard and mouse to XIV actions, custom macros/commands, and supported Dalamud plugins. Bind any key, including those not normally supported by the game (F13-F24) to *almost* anything as if it were an actual registered keybind!

Supported Keybinds:
- Custom Macros and Commands
- Supported Plugins
- Targeting*
- Shortcuts
- Chat*
- Hotbars

> * - Some features may be grayed out due to complexities or unavailability. Not all base game keybinds are in KeybindsPlus but may appear as updates progress.

(Thanks Miyabi)
presentation.summary: A almost complete replacement of XIV's keybind system.

variant.author: Bronya Rand
variant.changelog:
Keybinds Plus is a plugin that allows you to bind _almost_ any key on your keyboard to either a XIV keybind or a supported Dalamud plugin.

Keybinds Plus allows you to bind any key, including those that are not supported by the game (F13-F24) to almost any game function (Shortcuts, Chat, Targeting, Hotbars) as well as any plugin that implements KeybindsPlus' IPC. You can also bind a key to a custom command (like `/wlmark`) or macro just like how the game does.

Supported Keybinds:
- Custom Macros and Commands
- Supported Plugins
- Targeting*
- Shortcuts
- Chat*
- Hotbars

  > \* - Some features may be grayed out due to complexities or unavailability. Not all base game keybinds are in KeybindsPlus but may appear as updates progress.

This plugin is a early state and quite ambitious of me to do from prior plugins I've made. Why did I decide to write this? Simply put I wanted to use my Razer Miyabi keyboard macros and originally wanted to use F13 but game said no so I said `Fine. I'll do it myself.`  Also, past conversations. Thanks Miyabi :)

## AI Declaration
Code Usage: Assist
> Claude/Gemini was used only to inquire about what ClientStructs to use given my prior research to reading said ClientStructs aside from the people who suggested/pointed me to the right CS in #plugin-dev and reading code from other plugins that were a basis on Better Keybinds like Vanilla Plus, MouseLock, Chat 2, a bit of DelvUI and Better Targeting System in a way I could best understand it. All other code was written by me, borrowed from some Github searching for things and Google-fu.

Image Usage: None
> The icon (the M5 key button with the "No. 564" Miyabi identifier) was made by me in Photoshop with some SVG modifications to the "No. 564" image itself.
